0025,Pikachu,Pikachu,Scarlet,"When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks."
0025,Pikachu,Pikachu,Violet,"When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms."

0026,Raichu,Raichu,Scarlet,"Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked."
0026,Raichu,Raichu,Violet,"If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up."
0039,Jigglypuff,Jigglypuff,Scarlet,"When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep."
0039,Jigglypuff,Jigglypuff,Violet,"If it inflates to sing a lullaby, it can perform longer and cause sure drowsiness in its audience."
0040,Wigglytuff,Wigglytuff,Scarlet,"It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a body slam."
0040,Wigglytuff,Wigglytuff,Violet,"The rich, fluffy fur that covers its body feels so good that anyone who feels it can’t stop touching it."
0048,Venonat,Venonat,Scarlet,Poison oozes from all over its body. It catches small bug Pokémon at night that are attracted by light.
0048,Venonat,Venonat,Violet,"Its eyes act as radar, enabling it to be active in darkness. The eyes can also shoot powerful beams."
0049,Venomoth,Venomoth,Scarlet,"The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust."
0049,Venomoth,Venomoth,Violet,"When it attacks, it flaps its large wings violently to scatter its poisonous powder all around."
0050,Diglett,Diglett,Scarlet,"It lives about one yard underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground."
0050,Diglett,Diglett,Violet,"Its skin is very thin. If it is exposed to light, its blood heats up, causing it to grow weak."
0051,Dugtrio,Dugtrio,Scarlet,"Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow."
0051,Dugtrio,Dugtrio,Violet,"In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction."
0052,Meowth,Meowth,Scarlet,"All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow."
0052,Meowth,Meowth,Violet,"It loves things that sparkle. When it sees a shiny object, the gold coin on its head shines, too."
0053,Persian,Persian,Scarlet,"Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness."
0053,Persian,Persian,Violet,It has a vicious temperament. Beware if it raises its tail straight up. This is a signal that it is about to pounce and bite.
0054,Psyduck,Psyduck,Scarlet,"It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers."
0054,Psyduck,Psyduck,Violet,"If its chronic headache peaks, it may exhibit odd powers. It seems unable to recall such an episode."
0055,Golduck,Golduck,Scarlet,"When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow."
0055,Golduck,Golduck,Violet,"It swims gracefully along on the quiet, slow-moving rivers and lakes of which it is so fond."
0056,Mankey,Mankey,Scarlet,"It lives in groups in the treetops. If it loses sight of its group, it becomes infuriated by its loneliness."
0056,Mankey,Mankey,Violet,"It is extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment, then thrashing away the next instant."
0057,Primeape,Primeape,Scarlet,It becomes wildly furious if it even senses someone looking at it. It chases anyone that meets its glare.
0057,Primeape,Primeape,Violet,Some researchers theorize that Primeape remains angry even when inside a Poké Ball.
0058,Growlithe,Growlithe,Scarlet,It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.
0058,Growlithe,Growlithe,Violet,It’s very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.
0059,Arcanine,Arcanine,Scarlet,An ancient picture scroll shows that people were captivated by its movement as it ran through prairies.
0059,Arcanine,Arcanine,Violet,Its magnificent bark conveys a sense of majesty. Anyone hearing it can’t help but grovel before it.
0079,Slowpoke,Slowpoke,Scarlet,It is incredibly slow and dopey. It takes five seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.
0079,Slowpoke,Slowpoke,Violet,"It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail."
0080,Slowbro,Slowbro,Scarlet,"When a Slowpoke went hunting in the sea, its tail was bitten by a Shellder. That made it evolve into Slowbro."
0080,Slowbro,Slowbro,Violet,"If the tail-biting Shellder is thrown off in a harsh battle, this Pokémon reverts to being an ordinary Slowpoke."
0081,Magnemite,Magnemite,Scarlet,"The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float."
0081,Magnemite,Magnemite,Violet,It moves while constantly hovering. It discharges electromagnetic waves and so on from the units at its sides.
0082,Magneton,Magneton,Scarlet,Three Magnemite are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.
0082,Magneton,Magneton,Violet,They’re formed by several Magnemite linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.
0088,Grimer,Grimer,Scarlet,"Born from sludge, these Pokémon now gather in polluted places and increase the bacteria in their bodies."
0088,Grimer,Grimer,Violet,"When two of these Pokémon’s bodies are combined together, new poisons are created."
0089,Muk,Muk,Scarlet,"It’s thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison."
0089,Muk,Muk,Violet,"It’s so stinky! Muk’s body contains toxic elements, and any plant will wilt when it passes by."
0090,Shellder,Shellder,Scarlet,"It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender."
0090,Shellder,Shellder,Violet,"Clamping on to an opponent reveals its vulnerable parts, so it uses this move only as a last resort."
0091,Cloyster,Cloyster,Scarlet,"Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells."
0091,Cloyster,Cloyster,Violet,"When attacked, it launches its spikes in quick volleys. Its innards have never been seen."
0092,Gastly,Gastly,Scarlet,"It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin."
0092,Gastly,Gastly,Violet,"Its body is made of gas. Despite lacking substance, it can envelop an opponent of any size and cause suffocation."
0093,Haunter,Haunter,Scarlet,It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.
0093,Haunter,Haunter,Violet,"In total darkness, where nothing is visible, Haunter lurks, silently stalking its next victim."
0094,Gengar,Gengar,Scarlet,"To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey’s shadow and silently waits for an opportunity."
0094,Gengar,Gengar,Violet,"Hiding in people’s shadows at night, it absorbs their heat. The chill it causes makes the victims shake."
0096,Drowzee,Drowzee,Scarlet,It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats the dreams of adults because children’s are much tastier.
0096,Drowzee,Drowzee,Violet,"When it twitches its nose, it can tell where someone is sleeping and what that person is dreaming about."
0097,Hypno,Hypno,Scarlet,"When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of psi moves, such as Hypnosis and Confusion."
0097,Hypno,Hypno,Violet,"Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone nearby."
0100,Voltorb,Voltorb,Scarlet,"It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode."
0100,Voltorb,Voltorb,Violet,"It’s usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people."
0101,Electrode,Electrode,Scarlet,"The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode."
0101,Electrode,Electrode,Violet,"It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of the Bomb Ball."
0113,Chansey,Chansey,Scarlet,This kindly Pokémon lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.
0113,Chansey,Chansey,Violet,"It walks carefully to prevent its egg from breaking. However, it is extremely fast at running away."
0123,Scyther,Scyther,Scarlet,"It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track."
0123,Scyther,Scyther,Violet,The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.
0128,Tauros,Tauros,Scarlet,"When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails."
0128,Tauros,Tauros,Violet,They fight each other by locking horns. The herd’s protector takes pride in its battle-scarred horns.
0128,Tauros,Combat Breed,Scarlet,This Pokémon has a muscular body and excels at close-quarters combat. It uses its short horns to strike the opponent’s weak spots.
0128,Tauros,Combat Breed,Violet,"This kind of Tauros, known as the Combat Breed, is distinguished by its thick, powerful muscles and its fierce disposition."
0128,Tauros,Blaze Breed,Scarlet,"When heated by fire energy, its horns can get hotter than 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. Those gored by them will suffer both wounds and burns."
0128,Tauros,Blaze Breed,Violet,People call this kind of Tauros the Blaze Breed due to the hot air it snorts from its nostrils. Its three tails are intertwined.
0128,Tauros,Aqua Breed,Scarlet,This Pokémon blasts water from holes on the tips of its horns—the high-pressure jets pierce right through Tauros’s enemies.
0128,Tauros,Aqua Breed,Violet,"It swims by jetting water from its horns. The most notable characteristic of the Aqua Breed is its high body fat, which allows it to float easily."
0129,Magikarp,Magikarp,Scarlet,"An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet."
0129,Magikarp,Magikarp,Violet,"In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today."
0130,Gyarados,Gyarados,Scarlet,"Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it."
0130,Gyarados,Gyarados,Violet,"It appears whenever there is world conflict, burning down any place it travels through."
0132,Ditto,Ditto,Scarlet,"Its transformation ability is perfect. However, if made to laugh, it can’t maintain its disguise."
0132,Ditto,Ditto,Violet,It can freely recombine its own cellular structure to transform into other life-forms.
0133,Eevee,Eevee,Scarlet,Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.
0133,Eevee,Eevee,Violet,Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element stones.
0134,Vaporeon,Vaporeon,Scarlet,"It lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin, which is often mistaken for a mermaid’s."
0134,Vaporeon,Vaporeon,Violet,"Its cell composition is similar to water molecules. As a result, it can’t be seen when it melts away into water."
0135,Jolteon,Jolteon,Scarlet,It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.
0135,Jolteon,Jolteon,Violet,"If agitated, it uses electricity to straighten out its fur and launch it in small bunches."
0136,Flareon,Flareon,Scarlet,"Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac, heated, and exhaled as fire that reaches over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit."
0136,Flareon,Flareon,Violet,"It fluffs out its fur collar to cool down its body temperature, which can reach 1,650 degrees Fahrenheit."
0147,Dratini,Dratini,Scarlet,"It sheds many layers of skin as it grows larger. During this process, it is protected by a rapid waterfall."
0147,Dratini,Dratini,Violet,It is born large to start with. It repeatedly sheds its skin as it steadily grows longer.
0148,Dragonair,Dragonair,Scarlet,"They say that if it emits an aura from its whole body, the weather will begin to change instantly."
0148,Dragonair,Dragonair,Violet,"It is called the divine Pokémon. When its entire body brightens slightly, the weather changes."
0149,Dragonite,Dragonite,Scarlet,It is said that somewhere in the ocean lies an island where these gather. Only they live there.
0149,Dragonite,Dragonite,Violet,It can fly in spite of its big and bulky physique. It circles the globe in just 16 hours.
0172,Pichu,Pichu,Scarlet,It is unskilled at storing electric power. Any kind of shock causes it to discharge energy spontaneously.
0172,Pichu,Pichu,Violet,"Despite this Pokémon’s cute appearance, those who want to live with one should prepare to be on the receiving end of its electric jolts."
0174,Igglybuff,Igglybuff,Scarlet,"Its body has a faintly sweet scent and is bouncy and soft. If it bounces even once, it cannot stop."
0174,Igglybuff,Igglybuff,Violet,"It likes to sing but is not yet good at it. With praise and encouragement, it will get better little by little."
0179,Mareep,Mareep,Scarlet,"If static electricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you."
0179,Mareep,Mareep,Violet,"Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week."
0180,Flaaffy,Flaaffy,Scarlet,"As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won’t grow."
0180,Flaaffy,Flaaffy,Violet,"Because of its rubbery, electricity-resistant skin, it can store lots of electricity in its fur."
0181,Ampharos,Ampharos,Scarlet,The bright light on its tail can be seen far away. It has been treasured since ancient times as a beacon.
0181,Ampharos,Ampharos,Violet,"When it gets dark, the light from its bright, shiny tail can be seen from far away on the ocean’s surface."
0183,Marill,Marill,Scarlet,The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry even when it plays in the water.
0183,Marill,Marill,Violet,"The oil-filled tail functions as a buoy, so it’s fine even in rivers with strong currents."
0184,Azumarill,Azumarill,Scarlet,Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of things in water and tell what they are.
0184,Azumarill,Azumarill,Violet,"By keeping still and listening intently, it can tell what is in even wild, fast-moving rivers."
0185,Sudowoodo,Sudowoodo,Scarlet,"Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears more similar to rock than to vegetation."
0185,Sudowoodo,Sudowoodo,Violet,"To avoid being attacked, it does nothing but mimic a tree. It hates water and flees from rain."
0187,Hoppip,Hoppip,Scarlet,This Pokémon is blown across vast distances by the wind. It is unclear where the Hoppip of Paldea originally came from.
0187,Hoppip,Hoppip,Violet,"Outside of cold regions, Hoppip can be found practically everywhere. This is because the wind carries this species all over the world."
0188,Skiploom,Skiploom,Scarlet,Skiploom enthusiasts can apparently tell where a Skiploom was born by the scent drifting from the flower on the Pokémon’s head.
0188,Skiploom,Skiploom,Violet,"When the weather grows cold, Skiploom’s flower closes and the Pokémon cannot photosynthesize, so it flies away to warmer regions."
0189,Jumpluff,Jumpluff,Scarlet,"Jumpluff travels on seasonal winds. Once its cotton spores run out, its journey ends, as does its life."
0189,Jumpluff,Jumpluff,Violet,"Beware its cotton spores. If you accidentally breathe them in, you’ll be racked with coughs and itchiness."
0191,Sunkern,Sunkern,Scarlet,"It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning. Knowing it’s weak, it simply feeds until it evolves."
0191,Sunkern,Sunkern,Violet,It is very weak. Its only means of defense is to shake its leaves desperately at its attacker.
0192,Sunflora,Sunflora,Scarlet,"In the daytime, it rushes about in a hectic manner, but it comes to a complete stop when the sun sets."
0192,Sunflora,Sunflora,Violet,"Since it converts sunlight into energy, it is always looking in the direction of the sun."
0194,Wooper,Paldean Wooper,Scarlet,"After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body."
0194,Wooper,Paldean Wooper,Violet,It’s dangerous for Wooper to travel alone. They line up in groups of three or four and help each other as they walk around the wetlands.
0196,Espeon,Espeon,Scarlet,The tip of its forked tail quivers when it is predicting its opponent’s next move.
0196,Espeon,Espeon,Violet,It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its enemy’s actions.
0197,Umbreon,Umbreon,Scarlet,"When exposed to the moon’s aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it gains a mysterious power."
0197,Umbreon,Umbreon,Violet,"When darkness falls, the rings on the body begin to glow, striking fear in the hearts of anyone nearby."
0198,Murkrow,Murkrow,Scarlet,"Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night."
0198,Murkrow,Murkrow,Violet,"If spotted, it will lure an unwary person into chasing it, then lose the pursuer on mountain trails."
0199,Slowking,Slowking,Scarlet,"When its head was bitten, toxins entered Slowpoke’s head and unlocked an extraordinary power."
0199,Slowking,Slowking,Violet,"It has incredible intellect and intuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected."
0200,Misdreavus,Misdreavus,Scarlet,This Pokémon startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.
0200,Misdreavus,Misdreavus,Violet,"It loves to bite and yank people’s hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions."
0203,Girafarig,Girafarig,Scarlet,"Though very small, the brain in its tail is still considered an important organ because it emits powerful psychic energy."
0203,Girafarig,Girafarig,Violet,Girafarig’s tail has a small head. It instinctively bites at any foe that approaches the Pokémon from behind.
0204,Pineco,Pineco,Scarlet,It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn’t bother it.
0204,Pineco,Pineco,Violet,It spits out a fluid that it uses to glue tree bark to its body. The fluid hardens when it touches air.
0205,Forretress,Forretress,Scarlet,It’s usually found hanging on to a fat tree trunk. It shoots out bits of its shell when it sees action.
0205,Forretress,Forretress,Violet,Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside this shell is a total mystery.
0206,Dunsparce,Dunsparce,Scarlet,"It creates mazes in dark locations. When spotted, it flees into the ground by digging with its tail."
0206,Dunsparce,Dunsparce,Violet,"If spotted, it escapes by burrowing with its tail. It can float just slightly using its wings."
0211,Qwilfish,Qwilfish,Scarlet,Be cautious if this Pokémon starts sucking in water—it will soon attack by scattering the toxic spikes that grow all over its body.
0211,Qwilfish,Qwilfish,Violet,Experienced fishers say they try to catch Qwilfish in the brief moment that these Pokémon become defenseless just after launching poisonous spikes.
0212,Scizor,Scizor,Scarlet,"This Pokémon’s pincers, which contain steel, can crush any hard object they get ahold of into bits."
0212,Scizor,Scizor,Violet,It swings its eye-patterned pincers up to scare its foes. This makes it look like it has three heads.
0214,Heracross,Heracross,Scarlet,"It loves sweet nectar. To keep all the nectar to itself, it hurls rivals away with its prized horn."
0214,Heracross,Heracross,Violet,"With its herculean powers, it can easily throw around an object that is 100 times its own weight."
0215,Sneasel,Sneasel,Scarlet,"This cunning Pokémon hides under the cover of darkness, waiting to attack its prey."
0215,Sneasel,Sneasel,Violet,This is a smart and sneaky Pokémon. A pair may work together to steal eggs by having one lure the parents away.
0216,Teddiursa,Teddiursa,Scarlet,This Pokémon discreetly follows Combee to find their hive. It scoops up big dollops of honey in its palms to eat.
0216,Teddiursa,Teddiursa,Violet,"Its paws are soaked in oodles of honey. When nervous, Teddiursa will lick its paws and soon have a smile back on its face."
0217,Ursaring,Ursaring,Scarlet,"It usually wears a hardened expression, but when it’s licking up honey—which it loves—the joy it feels will cause it to break into a wide grin."
0217,Ursaring,Ursaring,Violet,"It is quite skilled at climbing trees. If it comes across a Primeape while searching for berries in the treetops, trouble will surely ensue."
0225,Delibird,Delibird,Scarlet,It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.
0225,Delibird,Delibird,Violet,"It always carries its food with it, wherever it goes. If attacked, it throws its food at the opponent."
0228,Houndour,Houndour,Scarlet,It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.
0228,Houndour,Houndour,Violet,It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.
0229,Houndoom,Houndoom,Scarlet,"If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away."
0229,Houndoom,Houndoom,Violet,"Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests."
0231,Phanpy,Phanpy,Scarlet,"This Pokémon lives and nests on a riverbank. After playing in the mud, it won’t be able to settle down unless it washes its body."
0231,Phanpy,Phanpy,Violet,"It is far stronger than it appears. If a Phanpy is swinging its trunk around and your arm gets hit by it, your arm bone will shatter."
0232,Donphan,Donphan,Scarlet,"Donphan is covered in tough hide, so even being hit by a car won’t faze this Pokémon. However, it is extremely susceptible to rain."
0232,Donphan,Donphan,Violet,"Donphan is normally a calm Pokémon, but once it is enraged, it will curl its body into a ball and charge at you while rolling."
0234,Stantler,Stantler,Scarlet,"This Pokémon apparently used to live in much harsher environments, and thus it once had stronger psychic powers than it does now."
0234,Stantler,Stantler,Violet,"It’s said that this Pokémon used to be stronger long ago when it had many enemies, and that it was even able to evolve under its own power."
0242,Blissey,Blissey,Scarlet,Anyone who takes even one taste of Blissey’s egg becomes unfailingly caring and pleasant to everyone.
0242,Blissey,Blissey,Violet,The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.
0246,Larvitar,Larvitar,Scarlet,"Born deep underground, this Pokémon becomes a pupa after eating enough dirt to make a mountain."
0246,Larvitar,Larvitar,Violet,It is born deep underground. It can’t emerge until it has entirely consumed the soil around it.
0247,Pupitar,Pupitar,Scarlet,This pupa flies around wildly by venting with great force the gas pressurized inside its body.
0247,Pupitar,Pupitar,Violet,"Its shell is as hard as bedrock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain."
0248,Tyranitar,Tyranitar,Scarlet,"Extremely strong, it can change the landscape. It is so insolent that it doesn’t care about others."
0248,Tyranitar,Tyranitar,Violet,"In just one of its mighty hands, it has the power to make the ground shake and mountains crumble."
0278,Wingull,Wingull,Scarlet,"It soars high in the sky, riding on updrafts like a glider. It carries food tucked in its bill."
0278,Wingull,Wingull,Violet,"It rides upon ocean winds as if it were a glider. In the winter, it hides food around its nest."
0279,Pelipper,Pelipper,Scarlet,It is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon in its beak. It bobs on the waves to rest its wings.
0279,Pelipper,Pelipper,Violet,"It protects its young in its beak. It bobs on waves, resting on them on days when the waters are calm."
0280,Ralts,Ralts,Scarlet,The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people’s emotions.
0280,Ralts,Ralts,Violet,It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.
0281,Kirlia,Kirlia,Scarlet,It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.
0281,Kirlia,Kirlia,Violet,The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.
0282,Gardevoir,Gardevoir,Scarlet,"To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole."
0282,Gardevoir,Gardevoir,Violet,It unleashes psychokinetic energy at full power when protecting a Trainer it has bonded closely with.
0283,Surskit,Surskit,Scarlet,"They usually live on ponds, but after an evening shower, they may appear on puddles in towns."
0283,Surskit,Surskit,Violet,"It secretes a thick, sweet-scented syrup from the tip of its head. It lives on weed-choked ponds."
0284,Masquerain,Masquerain,Scarlet,It flaps its four wings to hover and fly freely in any direction—to and fro and sideways.

0739,Crabrawler,Crabrawler,Scarlet,"This Pokémon punches trees and eats the berries that drop down, training itself and getting food at the same time."
