0740,Crabominable,Crabominable,Scarlet,The detached pincers of these Pokémon are delicious. Some Trainers bring Lechonk into the mountains just to search for them.
0740,Crabominable,Crabominable,Violet,"Though its punches are powerful, this Pokémon’s movements are sluggish. It blows icy bubbles from its mouth to immobilize its opponents."
0741,Oricorio,Baile Style,Scarlet,"This Pokémon is incredibly popular, possibly because its passionate dancing is a great match with the temperament of Paldean people."
0741,Oricorio,Baile Style,Violet,This form of Oricorio has sipped red nectar. It whips up blazing flames as it moves to the steps of its passionate dance.
0741,Oricorio,Pa’u Style,Scarlet,"The airy dance of these Oricorio is popular as a means of maintaining good health, but the Oricorio themselves are hard to find in Paldea."
0741,Oricorio,Pa’u Style,Violet,"This form of Oricorio has sipped pink nectar. It elevates its mind with the gentle steps of its dance, then unleashes its psychic energy."
0741,Oricorio,Pom-Pom Style,Scarlet,"This form of Oricorio has sipped yellow nectar. It uses nimble steps to approach opponents, then knocks them out with electric punches."
0741,Oricorio,Pom-Pom Style,Violet,"The energetic, cheerful dance of these Oricorio is popular with children, but the Oricorio themselves are hard to find in Paldea."
0741,Oricorio,Sensu Style,Scarlet,This form of Oricorio has sipped purple nectar. It uses ethereal dance steps to call forth the spirits of the dead.
0741,Oricorio,Sensu Style,Violet,"The elegant, attractive dance of these Oricorio is popular with adults, but the Oricorio themselves are hard to find in Paldea."
0744,Rockruff,Rockruff,Scarlet,"This Pokémon is very friendly when it’s young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master."
0744,Rockruff,Rockruff,Violet,"This Pokémon travels in a pack with others until it grows up. When its mood turns sour, it starts striking the ground with the rocks on its neck."
0745,Lycanroc,Midday Form,Scarlet,Lycanroc attacks its prey with its sharp claws and fangs. It loyally obeys the instructions of a Trainer it trusts.
0745,Lycanroc,Midday Form,Violet,"It has a calm and collected demeanor. It swiftly closes in on its prey, then slices them with the rocks in its mane."
0745,Lycanroc,Midnight Form,Scarlet,This Pokémon uses its rocky mane to slash any who approach. It will even disobey its Trainer if it dislikes the orders it was given.
0745,Lycanroc,Midnight Form,Violet,This Lycanroc has an extremely vicious temperament. It will happily sustain injuries for the sake of taking down its opponent.
0745,Lycanroc,Dusk Form,Scarlet,"Normally this Pokémon doesn’t even bark, but once it enters battle, it will relentlessly drive the opponent into a corner."
0745,Lycanroc,Dusk Form,Violet,These Pokémon have both calm and ferocious qualities. It’s said that this form of Lycanroc is the most troublesome to raise.
0747,Mareanie,Mareanie,Scarlet,This Pokémon wanders the seaside looking for food. It often gets electric shocks from broken Pincurchin spines that it tries to eat.
0747,Mareanie,Mareanie,Violet,"It has excellent regenerative capabilities. Legs that a Mareanie has lost have a very bitter, astringent flavor—they’re not suitable as food."
0748,Toxapex,Toxapex,Scarlet,This Pokémon lives within a dome made by its own legs. Toxapex monitors its surroundings by sensing the flow of the tide through its spikes.
0748,Toxapex,Toxapex,Violet,"Toxapex gets into fierce battles with Bruxish over areas where warm ocean currents flow, but the odds are always against it."
0749,Mudbray,Mudbray,Scarlet,This Pokémon covers itself in mud that it has regurgitated. The mud won’t dry out even if it’s exposed to the sun for a long time.
0749,Mudbray,Mudbray,Violet,"Though a slow walker, Mudbray is plenty strong. Its pace doesn’t change even when it’s loaded with 50 times its own body weight."
0750,Mudsdale,Mudsdale,Scarlet,This Pokémon has been treasured not just for its physical labor but also because it produces high-quality mud used for making pottery.
0750,Mudsdale,Mudsdale,Violet,"Its legs are fortified with mud and harder than stone, and they can reduce a large truck to scrap with one kick."
0753,Fomantis,Fomantis,Scarlet,Fomantis hates having its naps interrupted. It fires off beams using energy it gathers by bathing in the sun.
0753,Fomantis,Fomantis,Violet,Many Trainers give their Fomantis their own flowerpots so they can sunbathe in peace and quiet.
0754,Lurantis,Lurantis,Scarlet,"By masquerading as a bug Pokémon, it lowers the guard of actual bug Pokémon lured in by a scent of sweet flowers. Its sickles bring them down."
0754,Lurantis,Lurantis,Violet,A lot of time and effort is required to maintain the vivid colors of its petals. This Pokémon puts its Trainer’s attentiveness to the test.
0757,Salandit,Salandit,Scarlet,"It taunts its prey and lures them into narrow, rocky areas where it then sprays them with toxic gas to make them dizzy and take them down."
0757,Salandit,Salandit,Violet,Only female Salandit can produce gas laden with pheromones. Males entranced by this gas will do whatever the females tell them.
0758,Salazzle,Salazzle,Scarlet,"Salazzle makes its opponents light-headed with poisonous gas, then captivates them with alluring movements to turn them into loyal servants."
0758,Salazzle,Salazzle,Violet,"When two Salazzle meet, they will use their pheromone gas to fight over the males in each other’s group."
0761,Bounsweet,Bounsweet,Scarlet,"Its sweat is sweet, like syrup made from boiled-down fruit. Because of this, Bounsweet was highly valued in the past, when sweeteners were scarce."
0761,Bounsweet,Bounsweet,Violet,A Greedent drawn in by the sweet scent of these Pokémon will tuck the Bounsweet in among the berries in its tail and carry them all away.
0762,Steenee,Steenee,Scarlet,Steenee spreads a sweet scent that makes others feel invigorated. This same scent is popular for antiperspirants.
0762,Steenee,Steenee,Violet,"Steenee bounces energetically through forests. If the rind that peels off its body is pulverized, it can be used to treat stomach pains."
0763,Tsareena,Tsareena,Scarlet,"This Pokémon is proud and aggressive. However, it is said that a Tsareena will instantly become calm if someone touches the crown on its calyx."
0763,Tsareena,Tsareena,Violet,"This Pokémon launches fierce yet elegant kicks with its long, slender legs. It views Quaquaval as its rival."
0765,Oranguru,Oranguru,Scarlet,People used to mistake Oranguru for a human when they saw it issue command after command to the other Pokémon of the forest.
0765,Oranguru,Oranguru,Violet,"This Pokémon lives quietly in the depths of the forest. The purple, cape-like fur gets longer and longer as Oranguru ages."
0766,Passimian,Passimian,Scarlet,This Pokémon battles by throwing hard berries. It won’t obey a Trainer who throws Poké Balls without skill.
0766,Passimian,Passimian,Violet,The boss chooses 10 members of the group to go out hunting. The hunting party will evenly split the food they find with the rest of the group.
0769,Sandygast,Sandygast,Scarlet,"If it loses its shovel, it will stick something else—like a branch—in its head to make do until it finds another shovel."
0769,Sandygast,Sandygast,Violet,"It flings sand into the eyes of its prey and tries to close in on them while they’re blinded, but since Sandygast is so slow, the prey tends to escape."
0770,Palossand,Palossand,Scarlet,"The terrifying Palossand drags smaller Pokémon into its sandy body. Once its victims are trapped, it drains them of their vitality whenever it pleases."
0770,Palossand,Palossand,Violet,"From the hollows in its arms, it fires the bones of its victims, which are all dried up after being drained of their vitality."
0775,Komala,Komala,Scarlet,Komala spends its entire life sleeping. It feeds on leaves that contain a potent poison only Komala can break down.
0775,Komala,Komala,Violet,A potent anesthetic can be made by diluting Komala’s drool. This anesthetic was used for surgeries in the past.
0778,Mimikyu,Busted Form,Scarlet,"Even as it struggles beneath the cloth to repair the broken neck of its disguise, Mimikyu keeps up its impersonation of Pikachu."
0778,Mimikyu,Busted Form,Violet,"It has taken damage and can no longer hold the head of its cloth disguise upright. For as long as it lives, Mimikyu will never forget its attacker."
0778,Mimikyu,Disguised Form,Scarlet,"This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu."
0778,Mimikyu,Disguised Form,Violet,"Mimikyu was only recently identified as a Pokémon. Previously, people thought it was just a ghost wearing a cloth."
0779,Bruxish,Bruxish,Scarlet,It grinds its teeth with great force to stimulate its brain. It fires the psychic energy created by this process from the protuberance on its head.
0779,Bruxish,Bruxish,Violet,"When sunlight reflects on the ripples created by a Bruxish grinding its teeth, the water all around sparkles brilliantly."
0819,Skwovet,Skwovet,Scarlet,"It stores berries in its cheeks. When there are no berries to be found, Skwovet will stuff pebbles into its cheeks to stave off its cravings."
0819,Skwovet,Skwovet,Violet,"No matter how much it stuffs its belly with food, it is always anxious about getting hungry again. So, it stashes berries in its cheeks and tail."
0820,Greedent,Greedent,Scarlet,"If it spots a berry tree, it will immediately go to gather berries without a sideways glance—even if it’s in the middle of a battle."
0820,Greedent,Greedent,Violet,"This Pokémon makes off with heaps of fallen berries by wrapping them in its tail, which is roughly twice the length of its body."
0821,Rookidee,Rookidee,Scarlet,This Pokémon is brave and reckless. The white markings around a Rookidee’s eyes intimidate fainthearted Pokémon.
0821,Rookidee,Rookidee,Violet,"The females are fussier than the males. If another creature dirties a female Rookidee’s wings, it’ll peck the offender relentlessly in a burning rage."
0822,Corvisquire,Corvisquire,Scarlet,It’s said that the reason behind Corvisquire’s high level of intelligence is the large size of its brain relative to those of other bird Pokémon.
0822,Corvisquire,Corvisquire,Violet,This intelligent Pokémon will quickly learn how to use any tool it can hold in its beak or its talons.
0823,Corviknight,Corviknight,Scarlet,"Corviknight can’t serve as a taxi service in Paldea because the Pokémon’s natural predators will attack it while it flies, endangering the customer."
0823,Corviknight,Corviknight,Violet,"Although its wings have partly turned to steel and become heavy as a result, this Pokémon flies through the skies with ease."
0833,Chewtle,Chewtle,Scarlet,"Its large front tooth is still growing in. When the tooth itches, this Pokémon will bite another Chewtle’s horn, and the two Pokémon will tussle."
0833,Chewtle,Chewtle,Violet,A popular game among children is to lift up sticks that Chewtle have bitten onto to see whose Chewtle can hang on the longest.
0834,Drednaw,Drednaw,Scarlet,"Its massive, jagged teeth can crush a boulder in a single bite. This Pokémon has an extremely vicious disposition."
0834,Drednaw,Drednaw,Violet,"Drednaw lurks along the shoreline. When prey come to drink water, Drednaw stretches its neck out and chomps down on them."
0837,Rolycoly,Rolycoly,Scarlet,"On sunny days, Rolycoly will come out onto grassy plains and roll around. Then it will eat the grass that gets tangled in its wheel-like leg."
0837,Rolycoly,Rolycoly,Violet,Chunks of the surface of this Pokémon’s body that have grown old and flaked off have long been used for fuel as an alternative to coal.
0838,Carkol,Carkol,Scarlet,The temperature inside its body increases when it experiences strong emotions. It rolls around frantically while spewing flames.
0838,Carkol,Carkol,Violet,"Due to the coal tar created inside it, the heap of coal on Carkol’s back never falls apart, even when the Pokémon rolls around at high speeds."
0839,Coalossal,Coalossal,Scarlet,"To intimidate its opponents, Coalossal will vigorously shake its body, scattering coal from its smoldering back."
0839,Coalossal,Coalossal,Violet,"It’s gentle usually but fearsome when angered. With a body that burns at over 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit, it crushes foes and turns them to ash."
0840,Applin,Applin,Scarlet,It grows by eating the flesh of an apple. Applin uses its own body fluid to strengthen the apple’s skin and prevent it from rotting.
0840,Applin,Applin,Violet,"Applin lives inside an apple. When an Applin is separated from its apple, its body loses moisture and the Pokémon grows weak."
0841,Flapple,Flapple,Scarlet,"It flutters around while seeking an opening in the opponent’s guard, then attacks by spitting acidic liquid strong enough to melt metal."
0841,Flapple,Flapple,Violet,It uses its own body fluid to repair its apple. Strong Flapple that have won many battles have apples that are clay colored all over.
0842,Appletun,Appletun,Scarlet,It feeds mainly on sweet apples. It will also eat small bug Pokémon that are attracted by its sweet nectar.
0842,Appletun,Appletun,Violet,"When some Lechonk come along to lick the sweet nectar on Appletun’s back, Appletun will spew sticky nectar at them to drive them away."
0843,Silicobra,Silicobra,Scarlet,"Silicobra’s neck pouch, which can inflate and deflate like a balloon, gets more elastic each time Silicobra sheds its skin."
0843,Silicobra,Silicobra,Violet,"Silicobra’s large nostrils are specialized for spraying sand, so this Pokémon is not very good at telling apart different smells."
0844,Sandaconda,Sandaconda,Scarlet,"It will expand its body as much as it can and then contract itself, blasting out sand with enough force to wash away a dump truck."
0844,Sandaconda,Sandaconda,Violet,"The sand it spews contains sharp, pointy gravel, which is actually just sand that Sandaconda’s saliva has hardened into irregular shapes."
0846,Arrokuda,Arrokuda,Scarlet,Arrokuda can swim quickly only in a straight line. The ones that become sluggish from overeating are the first to be targeted by flocks of Wattrel.
0846,Arrokuda,Arrokuda,Violet,"It takes down prey by charging into them with its hard, pointed jaw. But Arrokuda’s eyesight is poor, so this tactic has a low success rate."
0847,Barraskewda,Barraskewda,Scarlet,"It spins its tail fins to leap from the water, then viciously bites down on Wingull flying close to the water’s surface."
0847,Barraskewda,Barraskewda,Violet,It swims at speeds of over 100 knots and battles fiercely with pods of Finizen over prey.
0848,Toxel,Toxel,Scarlet,It has no problem drinking dirty water. An organ inside Toxel’s body filters such water into a poisonous liquid that is harmless to Toxel.
0848,Toxel,Toxel,Violet,"This selfish, attention-seeking Pokémon stores poison and electricity in two different sacs inside its body."
0849,Toxtricity,Amped Form,Scarlet,"As it scatters toxic sweat and emits electricity, a melody that sounds like it came from a guitar reverberates through the surrounding area."
0849,Toxtricity,Amped Form,Violet,"The jolts of electricity it launches by violently strumming the protrusions on its chest easily exceed 15,000 volts."
0849,Toxtricity,Low Key Form,Scarlet,Many youths admire the way this Pokémon listlessly picks fights and keeps its cool no matter what opponent it faces.
0849,Toxtricity,Low Key Form,Violet,"As it gulps down stagnant water and generates electricity in its body, a sound like a rhythm played by a bass guitar reverberates all around."
0854,Sinistea,Antique Form,Scarlet,"Some fanatics will go to great pains to prepare the perfect tea and teacup, eagerly waiting for a Sinistea to come and possess their selections."
0854,Sinistea,Antique Form,Violet,"This Sinistea lives in an antique teacup. As valuable as this Pokémon is, its awful taste remains unchanged."
0854,Sinistea,Phony Form,Scarlet,The soul of someone who died alone possessed some leftover tea. This Pokémon appears in hotels and houses.
0854,Sinistea,Phony Form,Violet,"Sinistea gets into your body when you drink it, and then it steals your vitality from within. It also tastes awful."
0855,Polteageist,Antique Form,Scarlet,Apparently a Polteageist’s disposition is affected by the type of tea the Pokémon came from. What teapot it inhabits makes no difference.
0855,Polteageist,Antique Form,Violet,"Though risky to drink, this Pokémon’s tea tastes delicious. Gourmets who have no fear of danger drink Polteageist tea day after day."
0855,Polteageist,Phony Form,Scarlet,"The tea that composes Polteageist’s body has a distinct and enjoyable flavor. Drinking too much, however, can be fatal."
0855,Polteageist,Phony Form,Violet,These Pokémon multiply by creeping into teapots and pouring themselves into leftover tea.
0856,Hatenna,Hatenna,Scarlet,"Because the emotions of others constantly flow into its head, this Pokémon prefers environments where no other creatures live."
0856,Hatenna,Hatenna,Violet,"It senses the feelings of other living creatures. Be careful not to expose it to strong emotions for too long, or it will end up exhausted."
0857,Hattrem,Hattrem,Scarlet,"To this Pokémon, strong emotions apparently feel like incredibly loud noises—even if the emotions are happy ones."
0857,Hattrem,Hattrem,Violet,"The moment this Pokémon finds someone who’s emitting strong emotions, it will pummel them senseless with its braids to silence them."
0858,Hatterene,Hatterene,Scarlet,"Hatterene knocks out those that intrude in its home forest by blasting them with a beam, then slashing with claws enhanced by psychic power."
0858,Hatterene,Hatterene,Violet,Beware of forests that show no signs of living creatures within. You may have wandered into Hatterene’s territory.
0859,Impidimp,Impidimp,Scarlet,The reason this Pokémon causes trouble for those it feels close to is because Impidimp itself gets irritable if it can’t absorb negative emotions.
0859,Impidimp,Impidimp,Violet,"They live in groups, pestering and playing pranks on each other to polish their troublemaking skills."
0860,Morgrem,Morgrem,Scarlet,"Morgrem prefers dirty tactics, like ambushing, because it doesn’t have confidence in its brawn."
0860,Morgrem,Morgrem,Violet,This Pokémon absorbs negative emotions and turns them into energy. It’s popular with people who tend to think gloomy thoughts.
0861,Grimmsnarl,Grimmsnarl,Scarlet,This Pokémon has complete control over its hair. Grimmsnarl normally keeps its hair wrapped around its body to support its muscles.
0861,Grimmsnarl,Grimmsnarl,Violet,"It lives deep within the forest. Even after evolving into this splendid form, it hasn’t given up on its petty misdeeds and pranks."
0870,Falinks,Falinks,Scarlet,"The brass, which is the one that stands at the front and issues orders, is the strongest and smartest of the six."
0870,Falinks,Falinks,Violet,"The leader, known as the brass, uses its extendible horn to issue orders to the others when it’s time to change formation."
0871,Pincurchin,Pincurchin,Scarlet,This Pokémon generates electricity when it digests food. It uses its five hard teeth to scrape seaweed off surfaces and eat it.
0871,Pincurchin,Pincurchin,Violet,This Pokémon is so timid that even brushing against seaweed will make it discharge electricity in surprise. Its lips do not conduct electricity.
0872,Snom,Snom,Scarlet,"It eats snow that has accumulated on the ground. It prefers soft, freshly fallen snow, so it will eat its way up a mountain, aiming for the peak."
0872,Snom,Snom,Violet,"Within its internal organs, Snom amplifies the frigid air it gets from eating snow and then uses this amplified air to create icicle-like spikes."
0873,Frosmoth,Frosmoth,Scarlet,"Frosmoth senses air currents with its antennae. It sends its scales drifting on frigid air, making them fall like snow."
0873,Frosmoth,Frosmoth,Violet,"It causes blizzards as it flies around with its huge, chill-emanating wings. Clean meltwater is its favorite thing to drink."
0874,Stonjourner,Stonjourner,Scarlet,The elemental composition of the rocks that form its body were found to match the bedrock of a land far away from this Pokémon’s habitat.
0874,Stonjourner,Stonjourner,Violet,This Pokémon spends its life gazing at the setting sun. It strides leisurely across grassy plains on legs of rock that weigh over 400 pounds each.
0875,Eiscue,Ice Face,Scarlet,"On hot days, these Pokémon press their ice cube heads together and pass the time cooling each other down."
0875,Eiscue,Ice Face,Violet,"If you lick the ice covering its face, you’ll find it has a faintly salty taste. This species rode here on ocean currents from a cold, faraway land."
0875,Eiscue,Noice Face,Scarlet,"The ice that was covering this Eiscue’s face has shattered. Eiscue emits cold air from the tip of its hair to protect its head, which is sensitive to heat."
0875,Eiscue,Noice Face,Violet,"Contrary to its looks, Eiscue is a poor swimmer. It creates ice balls at the tip of its single hair to lure prey in and fish them up."
0876,Indeedee,Male,Scarlet,This Pokémon picks up on the positive emotions of other creatures via its horns and uses those emotions to fuel itself.
0876,Indeedee,Male,Violet,This Pokémon never leaves its Trainer’s side. It predicts their actions with its psychic power and takes care of their day-to-day needs.
0876,Indeedee,Female,Scarlet,"It dislikes conflict. If a fight occurs in its territory, it uses psychic power to throw things at the combatants in an effort to drive them away."
0876,Indeedee,Female,Violet,"In search of happy feelings—such as joy and gratitude—Indeedee bustles around, taking diligent care of people and other Pokémon."
0878,Cufant,Cufant,Scarlet,"Using the pointy tip of its trunk, it carves off chunks of hard rocks to eat. It is very docile and helps people with physical labor."
0878,Cufant,Cufant,Violet,"Cufant can lift loads weighing five tons. In the mornings, it heads into caves with its herd, in search of the ore on which these Pokémon feed."
0879,Copperajah,Copperajah,Scarlet,This Pokémon was brought to Paldea long ago by people from a faraway land. It’s so strong that it can easily pull an airplane.
0879,Copperajah,Copperajah,Violet,"Copperajah are prideful, cantankerous Pokémon. Specimens with vibrant green skin command the respect of others of their kind."
0885,Dreepy,Dreepy,Scarlet,"In the evening, groups of Dreepy will fly at high speeds over the ocean and poke at Pokémon in the water for fun."
0885,Dreepy,Dreepy,Violet,It has a habit of biting at Clauncher even though it doesn’t feed on them. This is said to be vestigial behavior from when Dreepy was alive.
0886,Drakloak,Drakloak,Scarlet,"This Pokémon flies around at over 120 miles per hour. If a Drakloak is defeated in a battle, its Dreepy will wander off without a second thought."
0886,Drakloak,Drakloak,Violet,"This Pokémon stores up energy in its lungs, then shoots it out. It takes care of Dreepy and battles alongside them until they’re all grown up."
0887,Dragapult,Dragapult,Scarlet,Dragapult can make its whole body transparent by clearing its mind and focusing. Even the Dreepy in Dragapult’s horns become invisible.
0887,Dragapult,Dragapult,Violet,The fastest Dragapult of the group is always surrounded by Dreepy that want to fly at sonic speed.
0906,Sprigatito,Sprigatito,Scarlet,Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.
0906,Sprigatito,Sprigatito,Violet,The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.
0907,Floragato,Floragato,Scarlet,"Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents."
0907,Floragato,Floragato,Violet,"The hardness of Floragato’s fur depends on the Pokémon’s mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp."
0908,Meowscarada,Meowscarada,Scarlet,"This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating."
0908,Meowscarada,Meowscarada,Violet,"With skillful misdirection, it rigs foes with pollen-packed flower bombs. Meowscarada sets off the bombs before its foes realize what’s going on."
0909,Fuecoco,Fuecoco,Scarlet,It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.
0909,Fuecoco,Fuecoco,Violet,"Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco’s head and flickers to and fro."
0910,Crocalor,Crocalor,Scarlet,The combination of Crocalor’s fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon’s head.
0910,Crocalor,Crocalor,Violet,The valve in Crocalor’s flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords. This Pokémon utters a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.
0911,Skeledirge,Skeledirge,Scarlet,The fiery bird changes shape when Skeledirge sings. Rumor has it that the bird was born when the fireball on Skeledirge’s head gained a soul.
0911,Skeledirge,Skeledirge,Violet,"Skeledirge’s gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit."
0912,Quaxly,Quaxly,Scarlet,This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.
0912,Quaxly,Quaxly,Violet,Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.
0913,Quaxwell,Quaxwell,Scarlet,"These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully."
0913,Quaxwell,Quaxwell,Violet,The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and Pokémon from various regions and incorporates their movements into its own dance routines.
0914,Quaquaval,Quaquaval,Scarlet,A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands.
0914,Quaquaval,Quaquaval,Violet,"Dancing in ways that evoke far-away places, this Pokémon mesmerizes all that see it. Flourishes of its decorative water feathers slice into its foes."
0915,Lechonk,Lechonk,Scarlet,It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn’t use it for anything other than foraging.
0915,Lechonk,Lechonk,Violet,This Pokémon spurns all but the finest of foods. Its body gives off an herblike scent that bug Pokémon detest.
0916,Oinkologne,Male,Scarlet,"Oinkologne is proud of its fine, glossy skin. It emits a concentrated scent from the tip of its tail."
0916,Oinkologne,Male,Violet,"It entrances female Pokémon with the sweet, alluring scent that wafts from all over its body."
0916,Oinkologne,Female,Scarlet,This Pokémon sends a flowerlike scent wafting about. Well-developed muscles in its legs allow it to leap more than 16 feet with no trouble at all.
0916,Oinkologne,Female,Violet,This is a meticulous Pokémon that likes to keep things tidy. It shrouds itself in a floral aroma that soothes the Pokémon around it.
0917,Tarountula,Tarountula,Scarlet,"The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon’s natural enemy."
0917,Tarountula,Tarountula,Violet,The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread’s strength is the topic of ongoing research.
0918,Spidops,Spidops,Scarlet,It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.
0918,Spidops,Spidops,Violet,"Spidops covers its territory in tough, sticky threads to set up traps for intruders."
0919,Nymble,Nymble,Scarlet,"It has its third set of legs folded up. When it’s in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs."
0919,Nymble,Nymble,Violet,It’s highly skilled at a fighting style in which it uses its jumping capabilities to dodge incoming attacks while also dealing damage to opponents.
0920,Lokix,Lokix,Scarlet,"When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order."
0920,Lokix,Lokix,Violet,"It uses its normally folded third set of legs when in Showdown Mode. This places a huge burden on its body, so it can’t stay in this mode for long."
0921,Pawmi,Pawmi,Scarlet,It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.
0921,Pawmi,Pawmi,Violet,The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.
0922,Pawmo,Pawmo,Scarlet,"When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks."
0922,Pawmo,Pawmo,Violet,Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.
0923,Pawmot,Pawmot,Scarlet,"This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements."
0923,Pawmot,Pawmot,Violet,Pawmot’s fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.
0924,Tandemaus,Tandemaus,Scarlet,"Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them."
0924,Tandemaus,Tandemaus,Violet,The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.
0925,Maushold,Family of Four,Scarlet,"The two little ones just appeared one day. The group might be a family of related Pokémon, but nobody knows for sure."
0925,Maushold,Family of Four,Violet,"The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight."
0925,Maushold,Family of Three,Scarlet,"They build huge nests with many rooms that are used for different purposes, such as eating and sleeping."
0925,Maushold,Family of Three,Violet,"The little one just appeared one day. They all live together like a family, but the relationship between the three is still unclear."
0926,Fidough,Fidough,Scarlet,This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough’s breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon’s vicinity.
0926,Fidough,Fidough,Violet,"The yeast in Fidough’s breath is useful for cooking, so this Pokémon has been protected by people since long ago."
0927,Dachsbun,Dachsbun,Scarlet,"The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon’s body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages."
0927,Dachsbun,Dachsbun,Violet,"The surface of this Pokémon’s skin hardens when exposed to intense heat, and its body has an appetizing aroma."
0928,Smoliv,Smoliv,Scarlet,It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.
0928,Smoliv,Smoliv,Violet,"This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head. It can easily go a whole week without eating or drinking."
0929,Dolliv,Dolliv,Scarlet,"Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone."
0929,Dolliv,Dolliv,Violet,"It basks in the sun to its heart’s content until the fruits on its head ripen. After that, Dolliv departs from human settlements and goes on a journey."
0930,Arboliva,Arboliva,Scarlet,"This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon."
0930,Arboliva,Arboliva,Violet,"This Pokémon drives back enemies by launching its rich, aromatic oil at them with enough force to smash a boulder."
0931,Squawkabilly,Green Plumage,Scarlet,"These Pokémon prefer to live in cities. They form flocks based on the color of their feathers, and they fight over territory."
0931,Squawkabilly,Green Plumage,Violet,"Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they’re out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy."
0931,Squawkabilly,Blue Plumage,Scarlet,"The largest of their flocks can contain more than 50 individuals. They fly around towns and forests, searching for food and making a racket."
0931,Squawkabilly,Blue Plumage,Violet,"Blue-feathered Squawkabilly view their green-feathered counterparts as rivals, since the latter make up the largest, most powerful groups."
0931,Squawkabilly,Yellow Plumage,Scarlet,"These Squawkabilly are hotheaded, and their fighting style is vicious. They’ll leap within reach of their foes to engage in close combat."
0931,Squawkabilly,Yellow Plumage,Violet,The yellow Squawkabilly are especially fierce. They’ve even been known to drive other bird Pokémon out of town.
0931,Squawkabilly,White Plumage,Scarlet,This Pokémon dislikes being alone. It has a strong sense of community and survives by cooperating with allies.
0931,Squawkabilly,White Plumage,Violet,"Though these Squawkabilly are the fewest in number, they have no trouble living in towns since they blend in with the white buildings."
0932,Nacli,Nacli,Scarlet,"It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt."
0932,Nacli,Nacli,Violet,"The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing it to leave salt behind. Salt is constantly being created and replenished inside Nacli’s body."
0933,Naclstack,Naclstack,Scarlet,This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey’s body.
0933,Naclstack,Naclstack,Violet,It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.
0934,Garganacl,Garganacl,Scarlet,Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.
0934,Garganacl,Garganacl,Violet,"Many Pokémon gather around Garganacl, hoping to lick at its mineral-rich salt."
0935,Charcadet,Charcadet,Scarlet,"Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents."
0935,Charcadet,Charcadet,Violet,"Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat."
0936,Armarouge,Armarouge,Scarlet,Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.
0936,Armarouge,Armarouge,Violet,"This Pokémon clads itself in armor that has been fortified by psychic and fire energy, and it shoots blazing fireballs."
0937,Ceruledge,Ceruledge,Scarlet,The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.
0937,Ceruledge,Ceruledge,Violet,An old set of armor steeped in grudges caused this Pokémon’s evolution. Ceruledge cuts its enemies to pieces without mercy.
0938,Tadbulb,Tadbulb,Scarlet,"Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies."
0938,Tadbulb,Tadbulb,Violet,"It floats using the electricity stored in its body. When thunderclouds are around, Tadbulb will float higher off the ground."
0939,Bellibolt,Bellibolt,Scarlet,"When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity."
0939,Bellibolt,Bellibolt,Violet,What appear to be eyeballs are actually organs for discharging the electricity generated by Bellibolt’s belly-button dynamo.
0940,Wattrel,Wattrel,Scarlet,"When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them."
0940,Wattrel,Wattrel,Violet,"These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they’re a popular delicacy."
0941,Kilowattrel,Kilowattrel,Scarlet,"Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day."
0941,Kilowattrel,Kilowattrel,Violet,"It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There’s hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer."
0942,Maschiff,Maschiff,Scarlet,"It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents take it seriously, but even crying children will burst into laughter when they see Maschiff’s face."
0942,Maschiff,Maschiff,Violet,"Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense."
0943,Mabosstiff,Mabosstiff,Scarlet,This Pokémon can store energy in its large dewlap. Mabosstiff unleashes this energy all at once to blow away enemies.
0943,Mabosstiff,Mabosstiff,Violet,"Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family."
0944,Shroodle,Shroodle,Scarlet,"Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire."
0944,Shroodle,Shroodle,Violet,"To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor."
0945,Grafaiai,Grafaiai,Scarlet,The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.
0945,Grafaiai,Grafaiai,Violet,"Each Grafaiai paints its own individual pattern, and it will paint that same pattern over and over again throughout its life."
0946,Bramblin,Bramblin,Scarlet,A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.
0946,Bramblin,Bramblin,Violet,"Not even Bramblin knows where it is headed as it tumbles across the wilderness, blown by the wind. It loathes getting wet."
0947,Brambleghast,Brambleghast,Scarlet,"It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it."
0947,Brambleghast,Brambleghast,Violet,"Brambleghast wanders around arid regions. On rare occasions, mass outbreaks of these Pokémon will bury an entire town."
0948,Toedscool,Toedscool,Scarlet,Toedscool lives in muggy forests. The flaps that fall from its body are chewy and very delicious.
0948,Toedscool,Toedscool,Violet,"Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph."
0949,Toedscruel,Toedscruel,Scarlet,These Pokémon gather into groups and form colonies deep within forests. They absolutely hate it when strangers approach.
0949,Toedscruel,Toedscruel,Violet,"It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy."
0950,Klawf,Klawf,Scarlet,"Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can’t remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head."
0950,Klawf,Klawf,Violet,"This Pokémon lives on sheer cliffs. It sidesteps opponents’ attacks, then lunges for their weak spots with its claws."
0951,Capsakid,Capsakid,Scarlet,"The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become."
0951,Capsakid,Capsakid,Violet,Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.
0952,Scovillain,Scovillain,Scarlet,The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire energy and blasts the surrounding area with a super spicy stream of flame.
0952,Scovillain,Scovillain,Violet,"The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it."
0953,Rellor,Rellor,Scarlet,This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures its mud ball more than its own life.
0953,Rellor,Rellor,Violet,It rolls its mud ball around while the energy it needs for evolution matures. Eventually the time comes for it to evolve.
0954,Rabsca,Rabsca,Scarlet,"The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball."
0954,Rabsca,Rabsca,Violet,An infant sleeps inside the ball. Rabsca rolls the ball soothingly with its legs to ensure the infant sleeps comfortably.
0955,Flittle,Flittle,Scarlet,Flittle’s toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon’s belly.
0955,Flittle,Flittle,Violet,"It spends its time running around wastelands. If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge."
0956,Espathra,Espathra,Scarlet,"It immobilizes opponents by bathing them in psychic power from its large eyes. Despite its appearance, it has a vicious temperament."
0956,Espathra,Espathra,Violet,It emits psychic power from the gaps between its multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater than 120 mph.
0957,Tinkatink,Tinkatink,Scarlet,"It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal."
0957,Tinkatink,Tinkatink,Violet,This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it’s satisfied with the result.
0958,Tinkatuff,Tinkatuff,Scarlet,"This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer."
0958,Tinkatuff,Tinkatuff,Violet,These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other’s hammers by smashing them together.
0959,Tinkaton,Tinkaton,Scarlet,"This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight."
0959,Tinkaton,Tinkaton,Violet,"The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home."
0960,Wiglett,Wiglett,Scarlet,This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.
0960,Wiglett,Wiglett,Violet,"Though it looks like Diglett, Wiglett is an entirely different species. The resemblance seems to be a coincidental result of environmental adaptation."
0961,Wugtrio,Wugtrio,Scarlet,"It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den."
0961,Wugtrio,Wugtrio,Violet,"A variety of fish Pokémon, Wugtrio was once considered to be a regional form of Dugtrio."
0962,Bombirdier,Bombirdier,Scarlet,"It gathers things up in an apron made from shed feathers added to the Pokémon’s chest feathers, then drops those things from high places for fun."
0962,Bombirdier,Bombirdier,Violet,"Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises."
0963,Finizen,Finizen,Scarlet,It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.
0963,Finizen,Finizen,Violet,Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from its blowhole.
0964,Palafin,Zero Form,Scarlet,This Pokémon changes its appearance if it hears its allies calling for help. Palafin will never show anybody its moment of transformation.
0964,Palafin,Zero Form,Violet,"Its physical capabilities are no different than a Finizen’s, but when its allies are in danger, it transforms and powers itself up."
0964,Palafin,Hero Form,Scarlet,This Pokémon’s ancient genes have awakened. It is now so extraordinarily strong that it can easily lift a cruise ship with one fin.
0964,Palafin,Hero Form,Violet,This hero of the ocean swims at a speed of 50 knots and saves drowning people and Pokémon.
0965,Varoom,Varoom,Scarlet,It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.
0965,Varoom,Varoom,Violet,The steel section is Varoom’s actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.
0966,Revavroom,Revavroom,Scarlet,It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders—now numbering eight—to generate energy.
0966,Revavroom,Revavroom,Violet,Revavroom viciously threatens others with the sound of its exhaust. It sticks its tongue out from its cylindrical mouth and sprays toxic fluids.
0967,Cyclizar,Cyclizar,Scarlet,"Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals."
0967,Cyclizar,Cyclizar,Violet,It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider’s body heat warms Cyclizar’s back and lifts the Pokémon’s spirit.
0968,Orthworm,Orthworm,Scarlet,"When attacked, this Pokémon will wield the tendrils on its body like fists and pelt the opponent with a storm of punches."
0968,Orthworm,Orthworm,Violet,This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It maintains its metal body by consuming iron from the soil.
0969,Glimmet,Glimmet,Scarlet,It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.
0969,Glimmet,Glimmet,Violet,Glimmet’s toxic mineral crystals look just like flower petals. This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder like pollen to protect itself.
0970,Glimmora,Glimmora,Scarlet,"When this Pokémon detects danger, it will open up its crystalline petals and fire beams from its conical body."
0970,Glimmora,Glimmora,Violet,Glimmora’s petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.
0971,Greavard,Greavard,Scarlet,It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the wild without ever interacting with a human was reborn as this Pokémon.
0971,Greavard,Greavard,Violet,"This friendly Pokémon doesn’t like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever."
0972,Houndstone,Houndstone,Scarlet,"Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master."
0972,Houndstone,Houndstone,Violet,A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn’t like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.
0973,Flamigo,Flamigo,Scarlet,This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.
0973,Flamigo,Flamigo,Violet,"Thanks to a behavior of theirs known as “synchronizing,” an entire flock of these Pokémon can attack simultaneously in perfect harmony."
0974,Cetoddle,Cetoddle,Scarlet,This species left the ocean and began living on land a very long time ago. It seems to be closely related to Wailmer.
0974,Cetoddle,Cetoddle,Violet,It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.
0975,Cetitan,Cetitan,Scarlet,"This Pokémon wanders around snowy, icy areas. It protects its body with powerful muscles and a thick layer of fat under its skin."
0975,Cetitan,Cetitan,Violet,"Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings."
0976,Veluza,Veluza,Scarlet,"When Veluza discards unnecessary flesh, its mind becomes honed and its psychic power increases. The spare flesh has a mild but delicious flavor."
0976,Veluza,Veluza,Violet,"Veluza has excellent regenerative capabilities. It sheds spare flesh from its body to boost its agility, then charges at its prey."
0977,Dondozo,Dondozo,Scarlet,"This Pokémon is a glutton, but it’s bad at getting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey."
0977,Dondozo,Dondozo,Violet,"It treats Tatsugiri like its boss and follows it loyally. Though powerful, Dondozo is apparently not very smart."
0978,Tatsugiri,Curly Form,Scarlet,This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.
0978,Tatsugiri,Curly Form,Violet,"Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack."
0978,Tatsugiri,Droopy Form,Scarlet,This species’ differing colors and patterns are apparently the result of Tatsugiri changing itself to suit the preferences of the prey it lures in.
0978,Tatsugiri,Droopy Form,Violet,"This Pokémon tricks its opponents by playing dead. It is small and weak, but it uses its smarts to survive."
0978,Tatsugiri,Stretchy Form,Scarlet,"Bird Pokémon are its main prey. This Pokémon knows it’s weak, so it hunts with a partner."
0978,Tatsugiri,Stretchy Form,Violet,It’s one of the most intelligent dragon Pokémon. It camouflages itself by inflating its throat sac.
0979,Annihilape,Annihilape,Scarlet,"When its anger rose beyond a critical point, this Pokémon gained power that is unfettered by the limits of its physical body."
0979,Annihilape,Annihilape,Violet,It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.
0980,Clodsire,Clodsire,Scarlet,"When attacked, this Pokémon will retaliate by sticking thick spines out from its body. It’s a risky move that puts everything on the line."
0980,Clodsire,Clodsire,Violet,It lives at the bottom of ponds and swamps. It will carry Wooper on its back and ferry them across water from one shore to the other.
0981,Farigiraf,Farigiraf,Scarlet,"Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of this Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig’s."
0981,Farigiraf,Farigiraf,Violet,The hardened head from the tail protects the head of the main body as Farigiraf whips its long neck around to headbutt enemies.
0982,Dudunsparce,Two-Segment Form,Scarlet,This Pokémon uses its hard tail to make its nest by boring holes into bedrock deep underground. The nest can reach lengths of over six miles.
0982,Dudunsparce,Two-Segment Form,Violet,"It drives enemies out of its nest by sucking in enough air to fill its long, narrow lungs, then releasing the air in an intense blast."
0982,Dudunsparce,Three-Segment Form,Scarlet,The gentle Dudunsparce will put Pokémon that wander into its nest onto its back and carry them to the entrance.
0982,Dudunsparce,Three-Segment Form,Violet,A recent study uncovered that the number of segments a Dudunsparce’s body has is determined by the Pokémon’s genes.
0983,Kingambit,Kingambit,Scarlet,Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.
0983,Kingambit,Kingambit,Violet,"Though it commands a massive army in battle, it’s not skilled at devising complex strategies. It just uses brute strength to keep pushing."
0984,Great Tusk,Great Tusk,Scarlet,Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. The name Great Tusk was taken from a creature listed in a certain book.
0984,Great Tusk,Great Tusk,Violet,"This creature resembles a mysterious Pokémon that, according to a paranormal magazine, has lived since ancient times."
0985,Scream Tail,Scream Tail,Scarlet,There has been only one reported sighting of this Pokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature depicted in an old expedition journal.
0985,Scream Tail,Scream Tail,Violet,It resembles a mysterious Pokémon described in a paranormal magazine as a Jigglypuff from one billion years ago.
0986,Brute Bonnet,Brute Bonnet,Scarlet,It is possible that the creature listed as Brute Bonnet in a certain book could actually be this Pokémon.
0986,Brute Bonnet,Brute Bonnet,Violet,It bears a slight resemblance to a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a cross between a dinosaur and a mushroom.
0987,Flutter Mane,Flutter Mane,Scarlet,"This Pokémon has characteristics similar to those of Flutter Mane, a creature mentioned in a certain book."
0987,Flutter Mane,Flutter Mane,Violet,"It has similar features to a ghostly pterosaur that was covered in a paranormal magazine, but the two have little else in common."
0988,Slither Wing,Slither Wing,Scarlet,This mysterious Pokémon has some similarities to a creature that an old book introduced as Slither Wing.
0988,Slither Wing,Slither Wing,Violet,This Pokémon somewhat resembles an ancient form of Volcarona that was introduced in a dubious magazine.
0989,Sandy Shocks,Sandy Shocks,Scarlet,"No records exist of this Pokémon being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match up with a creature shown in an expedition journal."
0989,Sandy Shocks,Sandy Shocks,Violet,"It slightly resembles a Magneton that lived for 10,000 years and was featured in an article in a paranormal magazine."
0990,Iron Treads,Iron Treads,Scarlet,This Pokémon closely resembles a scientific weapon that a paranormal magazine claimed was sent to this planet by aliens.
0990,Iron Treads,Iron Treads,Violet,Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. It resembles a mysterious object described in an old expedition journal.
0991,Iron Bundle,Iron Bundle,Scarlet,Its shape is similar to a robot featured in a paranormal magazine article. The robot was said to have been created by an ancient civilization.
0991,Iron Bundle,Iron Bundle,Violet,It resembles a mysterious object mentioned in an old book. There are only two reported sightings of this Pokémon.
0992,Iron Hands,Iron Hands,Scarlet,It is very similar to a cyborg covered exclusively by a paranormal magazine. The cyborg was said to be the modified form of a certain athlete.
0992,Iron Hands,Iron Hands,Violet,"This Pokémon shares many similarities with Iron Hands, an object mentioned in a certain expedition journal."
0993,Iron Jugulis,Iron Jugulis,Scarlet,"It resembles a certain Pokémon introduced in a paranormal magazine, described as the offspring of a Hydreigon that fell in love with a robot."
0993,Iron Jugulis,Iron Jugulis,Violet,"It’s possible that Iron Jugulis, an object described in an old book, may actually be this Pokémon."
0994,Iron Moth,Iron Moth,Scarlet,This Pokémon resembles an unknown object described in a paranormal magazine as a UFO sent to observe humanity.
0994,Iron Moth,Iron Moth,Violet,"No records exist of this species being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match up with an object described in an old book."
0995,Iron Thorns,Iron Thorns,Scarlet,It has some similarities to a Pokémon introduced in a dubious magazine as a Tyranitar from one billion years into the future.
0995,Iron Thorns,Iron Thorns,Violet,Some of its notable features match those of an object named within a certain expedition journal as Iron Thorns.
0996,Frigibax,Frigibax,Scarlet,"Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores."
0996,Frigibax,Frigibax,Violet,"This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator."
0997,Arctibax,Arctibax,Scarlet,"Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice."
0997,Arctibax,Arctibax,Violet,It attacks with the blade of its frozen dorsal fin by doing a front flip in the air. Arctibax’s strong back and legs allow it to pull off this technique.
0998,Baxcalibur,Baxcalibur,Scarlet,This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.
0998,Baxcalibur,Baxcalibur,Violet,It launches itself into battle by flipping upside down and spewing frigid air from its mouth. It finishes opponents off with its dorsal blade.
0999,Gimmighoul,Chest Form,Scarlet,"This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure."
0999,Gimmighoul,Chest Form,Violet,It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it’s actually a Pokémon.
0999,Gimmighoul,Roaming Form,Scarlet,"This Pokémon was born from passion that seeped into a coin. It wanders, apparently seeking to return to the treasure chest it once inhabited."
0999,Gimmighoul,Roaming Form,Violet,"It wanders around, carrying an old coin on its back. It survives by draining the life-force from humans who try to pick up its coin."
